Name: slightly cuter sprites for Shane

Description:
暂时包括谢恩，格斯，皮埃尔，乔迪，威利

需要前置 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]直接解压拖到Mods文件夹下，配合通用配置菜单[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿可以选择是否启用更改，也可以自己去config文件改，默认启用

Slightly cuter sprites for Shane and Gus,Pierre,Jodi,Wiily
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] required
Just extract and drag it to the "Mods" folder

Downloads.Description:
除谢恩之外的村民更改默认为关闭，可以用通用配置菜单或修改config.json打开

Except for Shane, the default setting for all other villagers is to be turned off. It can be enabled through the Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json
